description: The representative DP-LoRA condition and its accounting contract.

adjacency.note: 00 §8.2. The DP unit is one training record; no user-level or group-level claim is made.

target_epsilon.note: 00 §8.2 initial target epsilon ≈ 8. A target, never the achieved value.

delta.note: delta is a real DP scientific parameter, not a fixture convenience. 00 §8.2 requires an (epsilon, delta) mechanism but fixes only epsilon; delta is frozen against the real training-set size before the DP arm runs, and the frozen value is bound to the accounting provenance.

fixture_delta.note: Analytic accountant tests over tiny fixtures only. It must never become the real delta: the evidentiary path reads 'delta' and fails closed while that is REQUIRED_NOT_CALIBRATED.

clipping_norm.note: 00 §8.3 clipping. Frozen before the DP arm runs.

noise_multiplier.note: 00 §8.3 DP noise multiplier. Calibrated to the target epsilon at the real sample rate and step count, then frozen.

smoke_seed.note: 00 §8.2 DP_SMOKE seed = 101. One seed: plumbing only, never inferential.

inferential_seeds.note: 00 §8.2 minimum inferential DP set, required before any inferential DP-arm statement.

minimum_inferential_seeds.note: 00 §8.2: 1 seed = smoke/plumbing only; 3 seeds = minimum inferential DP set.

fixture_clipping_norm.note: Analytic accountant and clipping tests over tiny fixtures only.

fixture_noise_multiplier.note: Analytic accountant and noise tests over tiny fixtures only.

fixture_sample_rate.note: Analytic accountant tests over tiny fixtures only.

fixture_steps.note: Analytic accountant tests over tiny fixtures only.
